mechanism: Tetrabenazine is metabolized by CYP2D6 and dutasteride may have minor CYP2D6 inhibitory effects, potentially increasing tetrabenazine levels; both agents can cause orthostatic hypotension and CNS effects.
action: Monitor for increased tetrabenazine side effects (sedation, depression, parkinsonism) and blood pressure changes; consider tetrabenazine dose reduction if adverse effects emerge.
